arguments.command:
python - <<'PY'
import pandas as pd, re
x=pd.read_csv('b3_supercon_target.csv')
print('Samples:',len(x))
allowed=set('O Cu Ba Sr Y Ca La Bi Fe Nb C Pr As B Pb Ce Mo V Zn Ni'.split())
for _,r in x.iterrows():
 d={}
 for e,n in re.findall(r'([A-Z][a-z]*)([0-9]*\.?[0-9]*)',r.composition): d[e]=d.get(e,0)+float(n or 1)
 if set(d)<=allowed and (r.target>=45 or {'Y','Ba','Cu','O'}<=set(d)):
  print(r.composition,r.target)
print('Installed libraries:')
import sklearn, scipy
print('sklearn',sklearn.__version__,'scipy',scipy.__version__)
PY

OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 python - <<'PY'
import pandas as pd,re,numpy as np
from sklearn.ensemble import ExtraTreesRegressor,RandomForestRegressor
from sklearn.kernel_ridge import KernelRidge
from sklearn.model_selection import cross_val_predict,KFold
from sklearn.metrics import mean_absolute_error,mean_squared_error
D=pd.read_csv('b3_supercon_target.csv');ds=[]
for s in D.composition:
 d={}
 for e,n in re.findall(r'([A-Z][a-z]*)([0-9]*\.?[0-9]*)',s):d[e]=d.get(e,0)+float(n or 1)
 n=sum(d.values());ds.append({e:v/n for e,v in d.items()})
els=sorted(set().union(*ds));X=np.array([[d.get(e,0) for e in els] for d in ds]);y=D.target.to_numpy()
cv=KFold(n_splits=5,shuffle=True,random_state=42)
models=[('ExtraTrees',ExtraTreesRegressor(n_estimators=500,random_state=42)),('RandomForest',RandomForestRegressor(n_estimators=500,random_state=42))]+[(f'RBF gamma={g} alpha={a}',KernelRidge(alpha=a,kernel='rbf',gamma=g)) for g in [5,20,100] for a in [.01,.1]]
for name,m in models:
 p=cross_val_predict(m,X,y,cv=cv)
 print(name,'MAE',round(mean_absolute_error(y,p),2),'RMSE',round(mean_squared_error(y,p)**.5,2),'cuprates MAE',round(np.mean(np.abs(y-p)[(X[:,els.index('Cu')]>0)&(X[:,els.index('O')]>.3)]),2))
